blocks.text: MELBOURNE — A Filipino man who hacked his friend to death with a machete told police he believed the victim and others had killed a woman they called a “witch” to rob her. Christopher Reyes Gonzaga, 45, is on trial in the Victorian Supreme Court for allegedly murdering Gregory Tan, 45, in western Melbourne on April 15, 2024. Gonzaga did not dispute that he delivered the fatal blows, his barrister, John Lavery, told a jury on Tuesday. But the case would center on what prosecutors could prove about Gonzaga’s state of mind at the time, Lavery said. Following his arrest, Gonzaga told […]...
